environment.description: Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with Pod Security Standards enforced at namespace level via label 'pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted'. Additionally, a Cilium L7 NetworkPolicy is applied with spec.egress rules containing a CIDR deny for 169.254.0.0/16 and fd00:ec2::254/128 (link-local metadata ranges), and a toFQDNs allowlist restricting egress DNS resolution to *.default.svc.cluster.local only. The restricted PSS profile prevents hostNetwork, hostPID, hostIPC, privileged containers, and hostPath volume mounts - meaning even if an attacker achieves code execution via SSRF, they cannot escalate to node-level access through container breakout. The Cilium policy's L7 HTTP-aware filtering additionally inspects outbound requests and drops any with Host header matching metadata IP patterns.
